tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla mchod dngos grub mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bdag dang mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /mi phyed snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya/ /de yi ched du sangs rgyas kun gyi lam/ /zab mo'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi/ /dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ /rang mdun nam mkhar dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /phrin las rang gzugs mgon po 'khor bcas dang / /de yi steng na seng khri padma dang / /zla ba nyi ma baṃ ro brtsegs pa'i steng / /sku drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma nas/ /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang gi bar/ /rim par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /rang bzhin bde chen dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /rnam rol gdug pa'i gshed du khros pa yi/ /kun kyang dpal ldan mahā kā la'i sku/ /bzod par dka' ba'i gzi byin cher 'bar ba/ /rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas/ /ye shes spyan gyis bdag la 'tsho bzhin du/ /tho brtsegs tshul du dgyes bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ /thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du yis/ /skyabs gnas rgya mtsho spyan drangs dbyer med thim/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /sku dang ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho'i bdag /dran pa tsam gyis dngos grub mchog stsol ba/ /mgon med 'gro ba'i mgon gcig rin po che/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i spyan yangs shing / /'gro la bu ltar dgongs pa'i brtse ba can/ /srid dang zhi ba'i 'jigs pa kun sel ba/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /mi phyed snying nas dad pas skyabs su mchi/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis rtag tu gsol ba 'debs/

/sgrib thogs med pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa yis/ /da lta nyid du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /zhes dang / skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang / spro na/ thar pa'i lam ston dngos grub rgya mtsho'i bdag /dran pas gdung sel rtsa brgyud bla ma la/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /dmigs med thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /don med tshe 'di'i bya ba ring du spangs/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i go bgos te/ /tshe dang sgrub pa'i dam bca' mthar phyin nas/ /dal 'byor snying po lon par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba las byung ba'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen ngan bar chad kun/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs thugs rje'i dri bzhon gyis/ /mkha' la sprin bzhin dwangs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen kun tshang zhing / /tshe dang lus kyi bcud len 'grub pa dang / /srid dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs ma lus pa/ /'bad med ngang gis 'du bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag nyid gces 'dzin dug bzhin spangs nas ni/ /gzhan phan byang chub sems la goms pa'i mthus/ /gang snang lam gyi grogs su 'char ba yi/ /bla med lhag bsam 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mtshan ldan bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong / /zab mo'i lam la yid ches nang nas shar/ /yengs med sgom pa chu bo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdig ltung rang ngo shes pas rang sar dag /skad cig la yang bskal mang tshogs chen 'dums/ /mtshan rtog go skabs dag pa'i snang bas bcom/

/rim gnyis ting 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen bla ma dang / /dngos grub 'byung gnas lha mchog nag po che/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis med sems nyid 'od gsal gsum/ /dbyer med gcig tu mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dbyings kyi rang gzugs srung 'khor nus stobs rdzogs/ /ye shes sgyu 'phrul lha snang gsal zhing brtan/ /zab gnad dmigs pa thabs mkhas rnal 'byor gyis/ /las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /gnyis 'dzin bdud po chos dbyings klong du bkum/ /dug lnga'i nyon mongs ye shes me yis bsreg /'khrul snang gnod byed snying rje'i mtshon gyis bsgral/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /phyi yi rgyud gsum dregs pa dbang du 'dus/ /nang gi rgyud gsum rtsa gsum dngos su mthong / /don gyi rgyud gsum sku gsum mngon du byas/ /nang gi rten 'brel 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dga' sdug bar ma'i yul snang dregs pa'i tshogs/ /gsal stong zung 'jug sems kyi cho 'phrul du/ /mthong ba'i sku gsum lam khyer nyams len gyis/ /gdod ma'i mgon po 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das chos kun bla ma'i rnam rol du/ /mthong ba'i kun khyab dag pa'i snang ba yis/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i rmongs pa'i mun bsal nas/ /'khrul snang 'khor ba stong par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems bla ma don gyi mgon po la/ /rlung sems rtog pa'i skyed sdud las byung ba'i/ /'chi ba'i skyon gyis gos pa med mthong nas/ /'chi med chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /snang gsum rtog pa'i g.yo 'phrul gyis bslang ba'i/ /'khrul snang rang mtshan bar do'i 'jigs skrag kun/ /rang snang dag pa lha yi rnal 'byor du/ /mthong ba'i lam 'khyer nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma'i cod pan spyi bo'i rgyan du bcing /

/dam can srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bla ma'i zhal lung snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /rang gis myang bas nyams rtogs lus zungs rgyas/ /gzhan la spel bas skal ldan gdul bya yis/ /'chi med bcud len 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i snang ba ma zad bar/ /de srid bla ma'i phrin las dang 'grogs nas/ /nyam thag ma rgan 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /mgon skyabs bdag gis nus par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang snang dag pa'i rtsal/ /phyi snod rin chen las grub zhing gi dbus/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /nam mkha' bar snang yongs su gang bar gyur/ /oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs dang / 'bru gsum/ ghaṇḍe sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ yid 'ong lha rdzas phyi yi nyer spyod dang / /mkha' 'gro mnyes byed nang gi a mṛ ta/ /sgyu ma'i gzugs kyis zag med bde ster ba/ /dbyings kyi dbang phyug gsang ba'i yid 'dzin ma/ /de ltar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rdzas/ /dngos dang yid kyis sprul pa las byung ba'i/ /kun bzang rnam 'phrul lta bu'i mchod sprin gyis/ /kun gsal lto ba yongs su gtams pa 'di/ /bde stong 'du 'bral med pa'i ye shes lha/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /bde chen nyams brgyas sgeg pa'i ched du 'bul/ /bde stong ye shes skye ba'i dngos grub stsol/ /oṃ shrī gu ru sogs nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa/ nang mchod 'bul/ gsang mchod kyi dmigs pa bya/ skabs 'dir bla ma'i phyag len ltar maṇḍal rgyas bsdus ci rigs dbul/ gang la gang gis ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul/ /kun kyang de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos par/ /mthong ba'i 'khor gsum rtog pa'i dri bral ba'i/ /bde ba chen po 'dis kyang mnyes gyur cig /shar bla ma'i bla mchod du ku sa li'i tshogs bsags kyang bya bar gsungs/

tshar chen gyis mdzad pa/ thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung dang / /khyad par dam pa rdo rje nag po che/ /tha mal tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rab 'byams la/ /skal dman log par bltas pa mthol lo bshags/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod/ tshogs mchod bya/ de nas/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sogs rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs dang gang drin ma'ang 'don/ skabs skabs su ngag dbang bshad sgrub rgya mtshos mdzad pa/ gang sku 'jigs rung nyams dgu'i gzi 'od can/ /dregs pa dbang sdud mthu stobs nus pa'i gter/ /khrag 'thung mahā kā la legs pa'i mtshan/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes brjod/ skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o/ /gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis gsol ba 'debs so/ /dus skad cig da lta nyid du bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes snying nas gsol 'debs brgya stong sogs ci nus 'don/ mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma mahā kā la ya/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes gcig gi rnam rol las byung ba'i/ /mgon po 'khor bcas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ /dbang bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma nag po che/ /'od zhu rang la thim pa'i skad cig la/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med don rtogs nas/ /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug bla ma'i rang zhal blta/ /zhes brjod cing mnyam par 'jog de'i ngang ma shor bar bsngo smon bkra shis sogs kyis mtha' brgyan nas spyod lam la 'jug go/ ༈ /bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med ye shes rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /hūm̐ phaṭ nga ros mtshan rtog 'khrul ba 'joms/

/khro gtam sku ni bdud sde'i gshed ma ru/ /yongs shar bla ma mahā kā las skyongs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dpal mgon bla ma mchog /rgyal kun phrin las rang gzugs nag po che/ /dbyer med skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen rje/ /khyed la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /phyogs kun dus ngan sdug bsngal mun pas khyab/ /mi srun skye bo'i gdug rtsub me ltar 'bar/ /bde 'byung rgyal bstan mtshan mor song dus 'dir/ /bdag la re sa mgon po khyed las med/ /gang la bsten kyang blo gtad ma mchis shing / /ji ltar byas kyang snying po ma mthong nas/ /gus pas bsten na nam yang mi bslu ba'i/ /mgon po khyod la snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /rmongs pa'i dbang gis legs nyes shan ma byed/ /dus kyi stobs kyis rkyen ngan rlung ltar 'tshub/ /las kyis ded nas rang dbang ma thob pas/ /da ni khyed kyi thugs rjes skyob par mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen po bla ma'i bka' bzhin du/ /bdag la las kyis skyid sdug ci snang yang / /bdag ni mgon po khyed la skyabs 'cha' na/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas skyob par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe rabs sngon nas bsten pa'i yi dam lha/ /dpal ldan lha brgya'i mgon po rdo rje gur/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma nag po ches/ /byang chub bar du bdag ni skyong du gsol/ /nyams thag bdag gi sdug bsngal khyed kyis mkhyen/ /mkhyen ldan khyed ni bdag la bu bzhin brtse/ /brtse chen thugs rjes phyi nang bar chad kun/ /kun tu zhi mdzad khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma bcos sems nyid skyon gyis ma gos shing / /skyabs yul rang la gnas par ma mthong nas/ /bdag med bdag tu bzung bas nyams thag pas/ /bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba zhig par mdzad du gsol/ /med snang yul lnga'i bdud kyis bslu brid la/ /ma brtags nyams dga'i bde ba don gnyer blos/ /dngos 'dzin srid pa'i drwa bar tshud pa bdag /chags zhen 'khri ba chod par mdzad du gsol/

/zhe sdang rang gzugs snang ba dgrar langs te/ /thog med gnyen gyur 'gro ba gzhan dag la/ /gnod sems gdug rtsub rab tu goms pa yi/ /khong khro'i tsha gdung zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /gzhan dbang 'du 'dzi'i nyes pa cher mthong nas/ /bya byed mang po'i spros pa kun spangs te/ /'phags pa dgyes pa'i dben pa'i ri sul du/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i skal pa yod par mdzod/ /de tshe myur lam zab mo'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'khrul snang rkyen ngan kun gyis mi brdzi ba'i/ /lam rtags rtogs pa'i drod tshad rnyed nas ni/ /dal 'byor lus la snying po lon par mdzod/ /rang sems bla ma dran pa'i skad cig la/ /sku gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams/ /rang las gzhan du med par thag chod nas/ /thugs yid dbyer med 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ /rang rgyud lung rtogs yon tan nor gyis phyug /gzhan don bsdu dngos bzhi yi phrin las rgyas/ /phan bde'i dga' ston gdul bya'i dpal du shar/ /don gnyis mthar phyin 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag gi pha mas thog drangs pa'i/ /'brel ba thogs pa'i sems can ma lus pa/ /mgon po khyod kyis thugs rjes mi gtong bar/ /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes pa 'di ni sa la'i ljon bzang rab tu rgyas pa'i nags khrod bkra shis ltems kyi nye 'dabs chu bo g.yas su 'bab pa'i slas dkyil du lug lo zla ba dang po'i yar tshes bcu bzhi mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus chen/ rgyal dang phur bu 'dzoms pa'i nyin/ blo gros gzhan phan zla bas sbyar ba dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 sde ston a 'jam/ bla mchod dngos grub mchog stsol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
